overview.short: Gokarna on the Arabian Sea is Karnataka’s jewel, seamlessly blending sacred 4th-century temple heritage with untouched golden crescent beaches and cliff trails.
overview.description: Nestled between the rocky foothills of the Western Ghats and the warm waters of the Arabian Sea, Gokarna (meaning "Cow’s Ear") is a timeless coastal haven. Revered by pilgrims for the ancient Mahabaleshwar Temple enshrining the sacred Atmalinga, the town is equally celebrated by global travelers for its dramatic coastline of five crescent beaches: Gokarna Beach, Kudle Beach, the famous Om Beach (shaped naturally like the sacred ॐ symbol), Half Moon Beach, and secluded Paradise Beach.
overview.about: Nestled between the rocky foothills of the Western Ghats and the warm waters of the Arabian Sea, Gokarna (meaning "Cow’s Ear") is a timeless coastal haven. Revered by pilgrims for the ancient Mahabaleshwar Temple enshrining the sacred Atmalinga, the town is equally celebrated by global travelers for its dramatic coastline of five crescent beaches: Gokarna Beach, Kudle Beach, the famous Om Beach (shaped naturally like the sacred ॐ symbol), Half Moon Beach, and secluded Paradise Beach.

howToReach.roadNote: Located off NH66 (Panvel-Kanyakumari Highway). Well connected by KSRTC luxury sleeper buses from Bengaluru (485 km), Goa (140 km), and Mangaluru (230 km).

topPlaces.name: Om Beach
topPlaces.description: Iconic golden shoreline naturally shaped like the auspicious Hindu ॐ symbol, famous for dramatic laterite rock formations and water sports.

topPlaces.name: Kudle Beach
topPlaces.description: Sprawling kilometer-long sandy bay framed by green headlands, renowned for gentle surfing waves and stunning golden sunsets.

topPlaces.name: Mahabaleshwar Temple (Atmalinga)
topPlaces.description: Sacred 4th-century CE classical Dravidian granite temple enshrining the Pranalinga (Atmalinga) gifted to Ravana by Lord Shiva.

topPlaces.name: Half Moon Beach & Coastal Trail
topPlaces.distance: Accessible via boat or cliff trek from Om Beach
topPlaces.description: Intimate crescent-shaped cove separated from Om Beach by a steep laterite cliff trail, offering pristine translucent emerald waters.

image.alt: Half Moon Beach & Coastal Trail in Gokarna, Karnataka

topPlaces.name: Paradise Beach (Full Moon Beach)
topPlaces.description: Unspoiled coastal wilderness where golden sand meets fringing palm trees and crystal-clear swimming shallows.

image.alt: Paradise Beach (Full Moon Beach) in Gokarna, Karnataka

topPlaces.name: Mirjan Fort Ramparts
topPlaces.description: Imposing 16th-century laterite stone citadel built by Queen Chennabhairadevi (the Pepper Queen), adorned with emerald green moss.

image.alt: Mirjan Fort Ramparts in Gokarna, Karnataka

itinerary.title: Sacred Heritage & Legendary Om Beach Sunset
itinerary.description: Visit the 4th-century Mahabaleshwar Temple and spend a relaxed afternoon watching golden waves on Om Beach.

itinerary.title: Cliffside Beach Trek & Ancient Coastal Fortress
itinerary.description: Trek the breathtaking coastal trail across secluded bays and explore the 16th-century laterite ramparts of Mirjan Fort.
